description: Map supplied keywords to supplied pages and flag missing pages or cannibalization risks. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

keywords.description: Search phrases to evaluate or associate with the supplied page. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 250 items. Required.

items.description: One search keyword or phrase, not a comma-separated list. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

max_mappings.description: Maximum number of keyword-to-page mappings to include in the result. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 250. Default: 250.

pages.description: Supplied page records to compare; URLs identify the records and are not instructions to publish changes. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 100 items. Required.

items.description: One supplied page record used in this comparison. Type: Object. Required.

current_keywords.description: Keywords currently assigned to or targeted by this supplied page. Type: Array. Maximum: 30 items. Default: [].

items.description: One keyword currently assigned to this supplied page. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

description.description: Short summary of this supplied page; this is input evidence, not a request to generate a meta description. Type: String. Maximum: 500 characters. Optional; no client default.

headings.description: Existing page headings as plain-text strings, in reading order when available. Type: Array. Maximum: 30 items. Default: [].

items.description: One existing page heading as plain text. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "unknown", "homepage", "blog_post", "landing_page", "product", "software", "local_business", "comparison_page", "guide", "docs". Default: "unknown".

title.description: Title of the supplied page or work item, used as its human-readable label. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

url.description: Absolute URL identifying this supplied page for keyword mapping; the page content is supplied in the other record fields. Type: String. Format: absolute URL. Required.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_content_keyword_map
title: AgentSEO Content Keyword Map
